m.x:
The Map in which the cache objects are stored.

You can query the Map directly or use the BaseCache methods.
An instance of EventEmitter used by the cache to emit related events.

Adds an item to this cache. The item is referenced by a unique string, which you are responsible
for setting and keeping track of. The item can only be retrieved by using this string.

p.x: The unique key by which the data added to the cache will be referenced.
The data to be stored in the cache.

m.x:
Destroys this cache and all items within it. Clears the entries Map, removes all
event listeners from the EventEmitter, and nulls the internal references.

Checks if this cache contains an item matching the given key.
This performs the same action as `BaseCache.has` and is called directly by the Loader.

p.x: The unique key of the item to be checked in this cache.

r.x: Returns `true` if the cache contains an item matching the given key, otherwise `false`.

m.x: Gets an item from this cache based on the given key.

p.x: The unique key of the item to be retrieved from this cache.

r.x: The item in the cache, or `null` if no item matching the given key was found.

m.x: Returns all keys in use in this cache.

r.x: An array of strings containing all keys currently stored in this cache.

m.x:
Checks if this cache contains an item matching the given key.
This performs the same action as `BaseCache.exists`.

p.x: The unique key of the item to be checked in this cache.

r.x: Returns `true` if the cache contains an item matching the given key, otherwise `false`.

m.x:
Removes an item from this cache based on the given key.

If an entry matching the key is found it is removed from the cache and a `remove` event emitted.
No additional checks are done on the item removed. If other systems or parts of your game code
are relying on this item, it is up to you to sever those relationships prior to removing the item.

p.x: The unique key of the item to remove from the cache.
